resources.string: No game yet.\n\nTap the button below and pick your own Xbox 360 game: a disc image (.iso) or a .zip. The phone builds the game from it.
Rebuilds \"%1$s\" for this version of the launcher. The game files, saves and settings stay; usually about a minute.
This game wasn\'t built on this phone: add it again instead.
No log yet: play once first.

Automatic: the built-in Turnip on an Adreno 8xx, the system driver on any other GPU. Built-in Turnip: always (for an Adreno 8xx). System driver: the phone\'s own. Custom driver: a driver file you choose.
Full info shows a bar at the top: GPU and CPU load, memory, power draw, temperature and an FPS graph. Handy to see what slows the game down.

Xenia emulates the Xbox 360\'s graphics chip: the most tested way. Native draws the game\'s scenes with Vulkan directly, without that emulation; it is new, so if something looks wrong, switch back to Xenia and send a bug report. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Writes the GPU\'s measurements into the game\'s log (a little slower). Turn it on, play the part that misbehaves, then Report a bug.

Touch: press and drag anywhere free on the left half to move; swipe the right half to look. The camera stops as soon as your finger stops moving. On-screen buttons and the D-pad remain available. Adjust camera sensitivity in the game settings, when supported.

1. Copy your own game to this phone: the disc image (.iso) of Dragon Age: Origins, or a .zip with your game (Dragon Age: Origins' disc image, or State of Decay's folder from your console's storage).

2. Tap + and pick it.

3. Installing includes the static recompilation of the game's code for the phone: 5–10 minutes, plus copying the game files. You can leave the launcher meanwhile.

4. Tap Play.

The game is your own copy: nothing of it comes with this app.

XDroid360 is MIT-licensed, except its native renderer, which is GPL-3.0. Dragon Age: Origins' game library links it, so that library and this app are GPL-3.0 as a whole (source: github.com/udarmolota/XDroid360 at the release's tag). It carries:

• The native renderer: nfsmw-android by codepdbh, after nfsmw-nx (StevensND), NFSMW-Recompiled (madelrandel-blip) and NFSMW-Recompiled-Mobile (victorgbd) (GPL-3.0); ReXGlue SDK (BSD 3-Clause)
• SDL 3 (zlib)
• Mesa Turnip, StevenMXZ's Gen8 build (MIT)
• liblinkernsbypass (BSD 2-Clause)
• AndroidX, Material Components, Material icons (Apache-2.0)
• LLVM clang, lld, libc++, libunwind, compiler-rt (Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception)
• Android NDK sysroot (Apache-2.0, BSD; Android SDK License Agreement)
• XenonRecomp, the recompiler the launcher runs (GPL-2.0+ as a whole, for its binutils disassembler; source: github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp at ddd128bc plus scripts/patch_recompiler.py at 86b9d0b of github.com/udarmolota/Dragon-Age-Origins-Recomp-Android)
• shaderlib, the shader translator the launcher runs (GPL-3.0 as a whole), with XenosRecomp, fmt, xxHash (MIT, BSD)
• DirectXShaderCompiler (University of Illinois/NCSA), with SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Headers, DirectX-Headers (Apache-2.0, MIT)
• XenonUtils (MIT)
• DAORecomp by 96dot, SoDRecomp (MIT)
• Xenia (BSD 3-Clause)
• Vulkan-Headers, VulkanMemoryAllocator, glslang, fmt, xxHash, Snappy, Dear ImGui, toml++, SIMDe, FidelityFX (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD)
• FFmpeg 8.0, has207/FFmpeg (LGPL 2.1+; source: github.com/has207/FFmpeg)
• libmspack (LGPL 2.1), tiny-AES-c (Unlicense), TinySHA1

The full texts are in the licenses/ folders of the kit and the game profiles inside the APK, and in NOTICE.md at github.com/udarmolota/XDroid360.

XDroid360: Xbox 360 games on Android, built on DAORecomp by 96dot, Xenia's Vulkan backend and Mesa's Turnip. Made with the help of AI.

No game code or data comes with this app: the phone builds each game from the player's own disc.

Dragon Age is a trademark of Electronic Arts; this project is not affiliated with EA or BioWare.
Delete the development build\'s game \"%1$s\" with its saves? Export the saves first if you want to keep them. Added games aren\'t touched.
Something went wrong? Send a report.

1. Choose the game above.
2. Tap Send by email.
3. Pick your mail app (Gmail, Outlook…).
4. Write a few words about what happened and send.
No mail app on this device?
Save the report to a file, then send it from any device to this address. Attach the file and write a few words about what happened.
Save the report to a file
No mail app found: save the report to a file instead.

KEY=VALUE, one per line, for troubleshooting: TU_DEBUG=sysmem (Turnip), DAO_PERF_OVERLAY=0, DAO_PROFILE=20 (CPU profile in dao.log), DAO_GPU_STATS=1 (GPU work per frame in dao.log), DAO_GPU_FRAME_TRACE=<frame>. They win over the settings above. Saved to userdata/env.txt when you leave this screen.
Add a game first: import and export work on a game\'s saves and its gamepad layout.
A .zip of saves: from another phone, another game card, or Dragon Age: Origins Recompiled on a PC. Saves with the same name are replaced.
All this game\'s saves into one .zip, to keep or to move to another phone.
A layout file exported from XDroid360: the buttons go where they were there. It replaces this game\'s layout.
Where you put this game\'s on-screen buttons, as a small file, to use on another phone or another game card.
This isn\'t an XDroid360 gamepad layout
A lower limit means less heat and longer battery; the game\'s own Graphics settings change the same value. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
No 24-bit depth buffer: a 32-bit one is used instead.
